setup: The standard error of the mean is the standard deviation divided by the square root of the sample size: \(\mathrm{SE} = s/\sqrt{n}\).

steps.say: The square root of the sample size: \(\sqrt{[[size]]} = [[root]]\).
Divide the standard deviation by it: \([[sd]] / [[root]] = [[standard_error]]\).

answer: So the standard error is [[standard_error]]: more data makes the estimate of the mean more precise, which the division by the root expresses.
